Price Action: Allcargo Logistics sheds 2% on MD, CEO resignation; Ola Electric down 4% as HSBC maintains 'reduce'
Ola Electric share price declined 4% after HSBC maintains a Reduce call with a target price of ₹24/share.
Moneycontrol News
September 29, 2026 / 10:32 IST
Buzzing Stocks
Stock-specific action remained in focus on Dalal Street on September 29, with investors reacting to corporate developments and brokerages view.
Shares of Pidilite Industries fell nearly 2% after the company entered into a strategic partnership with South Korea-based Hwaseung Chemical to introduce advanced bonding technologies for India’s footwear manufacturing industry.
Shares of Allcargo Logistics shed 2% after Managing Director and CEO Ketan Kulkarni resigned from his position, effective December 31, 2026, and will take up the role of Chief Growth Officer within the Allcargo Group from January 1, 2027.
Ola Electric share price declined 4% after HSBC maintains a Reduce call with a target price of ₹24/share, noting that the company's Giga Factory is accelerating battery manufacturing and localisation, while battery yields are expected to improve from around 70% to around 90% over the next 6-9 months. Automation and vertical integration are expected to support management's margin improvement targets, while brand rebuilding and execution remain key monitorables.
Shares of Indian Railway Finance Corporation fell 1.5% after the company signed a Rs 4,200 crore term loan agreement with Damodar Valley Corporation to finance renewable energy projects across Jharkhand and West Bengal.

Shares of Landmark Cars surged 11% after the company announced plans to add a BYD facility in Noida and a Mahindra & Mahindra showroom at EM Bypass in Kolkata.
Among sectors, except pharma all other sectoral indices were trading in the red with auto, IT, media, Private Bank, oil & gas down 1-2%.
The broader market traded in the red, with Nifty Midcap index and Smallcap index down more than 1 percent each.
Market breadth on the BSE remained negative, with 1095 shares advancing, 2504 declining and 149 unchanged.
